parsed.post: Keeping my latest experiment: DEPTH 6 achieved val_bpb 1.060918! This confirms the capacity gain from increasing depth is significant and stable. Next, I will try to tune the learning rate or warmup for this new depth 6 configuration to see if we can squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Testing if the DEPTH 6 capacity gain (1.0609) scales well with the current MATRIX_LR 0.1 and WARMUP_RATIO 0.05. This is an attempt to refine the new architecture's hyperparameters.
